summary: Oragenics filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, under Items 7.01 and 8.01, disclosing its investor presentation and press releases about participation in Sidoti's Micro-Cap Virtual Conference. No specific transaction, corporate action, or special situation is announced or described. The filing is a routine disclosure of investor relations activities and an update to shareholders, lacking any terms, dates, or board recommendations tied to a special situation. Thus, it does not qualify as any of the special-situation categories, and 'None' is the appropriate classification.
